authority.answer_construction: Every supported occurrence, dependency, gap, and relationship was adjudicated from the seven pinned raw source captures and the frozen source-fidelity resolver before the selected-cohort classifier run.
authority.scope: Exactly seven fresh source facts. This is the single final held-out evaluation for Milestone 6 C2.
authority.source_authority: Raw capture bytes, canonical catalog fact identity, structural block order, and source-fidelity-resolved source facts only.
authority.operation_basis: Operations identify the source verb class; exact source quote and canonical capability/dependency jointly define the scored occurrence.
owner_contracts: Every distinct owned attack explicitly repeated more than once has one direct_damage and one multi_hit_action atom per attack definition.
Formula, sequence, and child-definition prose does not create attack atoms.
A required pre-existing stack is requires_stack; resource consumption is an explicit unsupported gap and never requires_stack.
Zone and stack conditions remain local to the source branch that states them.
Child requirements, branch conditions, and embedded definitions do not propagate to neighboring effects.
